title: A Shark Under Two Feet Long Took Bites Out of US Navy Submarines
subject: cookiecutter shark

scenes.text: A shark you could carry has taken round bites out of whales and submarines.
It's the cookiecutter shark. It grows to about twenty inches and lives deep, around 3,300 feet down.
It attacks animals far bigger than itself, large whales and big fish, leaving small, circular wounds.
Its belly glows blue-green, except for a dark patch that looks like a small fish to predators.
It has also bitten US Navy submarines, damaging the rubber sonar domes and forcing repairs.
A shark small enough to carry once sidelined a submarine.

description:
The cookiecutter shark grows only to about twenty inches, yet it takes round bites out of whales and large fish.
Its belly glows blue-green with a dark patch that lures predators, and it has damaged sonar domes on US Navy submarines.
What is the strangest thing you think a shark has ever bitten?
first_comment: A shark under two feet long damaged a submarine. Which small animal is the most dangerous for its size?
